_note: Optional email capture (UX-12). Off while captureEndpoint is empty: nothing is shown and nothing is sent. To switch it on all of captureEndpoint (a same-origin path such as /api), privacyUrl and both wordings must be set. The wordings are the exact text shown beside each unticked box and must be approved before use; change an id whenever the text changes, because the id is stored with each consent.
